effects: Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a qualifying damage over time ability triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals additional damage equal to 20-30% of your maximum life points.
Grasp of Guthix deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage in a 3x3 area.
body.name: Tearing Thorns

assumptions: Qualifying DoT abilities are explicitly marked in the combat ability catalogue; poison ticks, conjure and familiar damage, converted channels, and equipment procs are excluded.
The duration extension doubles the number of scheduled DoT hits at the ability's declared cadence; it does not alter tick cadence or damage bands.
The fifth qualifying hit advances a persistent rotation counter. Each Grasp is represented as separate maximum-life and poison components, and each component uses the same 3x3 target count.
The 3x3 target count is the resolved area-target scenario capped at 9. Poison immunity removes only the poison component; maximum-life damage remains eligible.

reason: Wire Tearing Thorns duration, hit counter, and Grasp components through the canonical blessing contract.

effects: Your effective critical strike chance is capped at 50%.
All excess critical strike chance is converted into critical strike damage at a 1:1 ratio.
Inferno of Zamorak gains 50% critical strike damage.
Every eligible critical hit unleashes an Inferno of Zamorak.
body.name: Unholy Critual

assumptions: The uncapped chance includes configured chance, equipment, set, Icyenic Faith, True Equilibrium, ability and land-time crit layers. Effective chance is capped at 50%; excess converts 1:1 to crit damage.

Inferno of Zamorak is a separate critical-eligible hit and can host Big Boned, but cannot trigger Cinders. Cinders and Unholy Critual remain independent on the original hit and can each create an Inferno.
When an Inferno crits, its Unholy Critual continuation is represented by a closed-form geometric expectation; it is not discarded or recursively enqueued.

reason: Wire Unholy Critual chance conversion and recursive Inferno expectation through the canonical blessing contract.

effects: The original Abyssal Cinders Inferno activation chance is increased from 5% to 25%.
The original Barkscales Grasp activation requirement is reduced from 5 reductions to 2.
Striking Light cooldown is reduced to 4.8 seconds.
body.name: Perfidious

assumptions: The Cinders multiplier applies only to the original Abyssal Cinders trigger; it does not change Unholy Critual's guaranteed critical-hit trigger or recursively modify Inferno events.
The two-reduction threshold applies only to the original Barkscales incoming-damage counter; Tearing Thorns remains a five-DoT-hit counter.
The 8-tick cooldown applies only to Striking Light; Lord of Light retains its independent 24-tick cooldown.

reason: Wire Perfidious origin-scoped upgrades for Cinders, Barkscales, and Striking Light.
